title: Chance by blaukreuz
author: blaukreuz
sourceDescription: Field recording of the spectator's perspective of a German Regions' League football game in Leipzig's Red Bull Arena, on April 28th 2013. RB Leipzig is playing against FC Magdeburg. The recorder is situated amongst several spectators of all ages, several children are present and heard.
modifications: cut 0.15-6.15s window; mono 22050 Hz; MP3 48 kbps; peak gain +0.00 dB (peak -12.70 dBFS); 30 ms fades
